source_note: Original community practice path. Each round is a separate attempt. Content is an AI-assisted preview awaiting practitioner review and calibration; this is not an employer process or a hiring-readiness certification.
name: Career Change and Return to Work
blurb: Map evidence to a role, translate a transferable skill, and rehearse your return-to-work story without needing to disclose private circumstances.

rounds.title: Match Your Evidence to a Job Description
rounds.focus: Practice a job-description walkthrough: relevant examples, honest gaps, and a focused learning plan.

rounds.title: Explain a Career Change
rounds.focus: Turn existing experience into credible evidence for a new field without pretending the roles are identical.

rounds.title: Return to Work with a Clear Skills Story
rounds.focus: Rehearse current strengths, refreshed skills, and onboarding questions while keeping personal circumstances private.
